title: Edible 솔로 #050 · hourglass bombshell · 연한 레몬골드 꿀 · 손 허리 · 공항 터미널 · 푸시아 립
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, wolf cut auburn hair — full body pale lemon-gold honey-filled honeycomb fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is real honeycomb wax and honey curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, thick golden honey streaming from the cells down her body in long glossy strands and pooling in shining puddles around her feet, nothing lying flat. Dense surface — BLAZING hexagonal wax cells brimming with pale lemon-gold honey across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID warm orange pools of honey shimmering inside every cell, with fine edible gold-leaf flecks scattered across the surface, wet glossy, richly saturated in colour, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same honeycomb wax, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, made of the same honeycomb wax with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a gold belly chain with a small pendant resting on her belly plate, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT honeycomb — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque satin vivid fuchsia-red lips, soft pink eyeshadow, defined lashes, a flushed pink blush.

Background: a bright airy airport terminal hall with a glossy pale floor, floor-to-ceiling windows, standard-height doors and a row of seats, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
